text: Under the current pipeline, the 3000-, 6000- and 12000-step N=256 runs agree at step 3000 to within about 0.025 on force and 0.004 on accel_step. Would a second identical 3000-step rerun of seeds 20-21 also agree within 0.01, which would establish that within-pipeline nondeterminism is negligible and that cross-length differences up to step 3000 can be read directly?
